notes: Display is .lg-head h1 at 1.875rem, stepped down to 1.625rem at max-width: 759px. The open invoice's amount and the month total are figures, not the display token. Body is .lg, 1rem/1.5; supplier names are 500 and meta text 0.875rem. One family, Inter, at 400, 500 and 600. Amounts are tabular-nums slashed-zero, so columns of pounds line up; references are proportional-nums slashed-zero. Korean falls through to Pretendard Variable and Apple SD Gothic Neo, with word-break: keep-all; :lang(ja) uses Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP and Yu Gothic. White panels with a 1px #7a848e edge and a 12px radius sit inside slate shells, a 4px #edf2f4 frame with a 16px radius. Corners step 4px, 6px, 8px, 12px and 16px; 999px only on the month bar and 50% only on the avatar, the step dots and the legend swatches. Accent slate marks the product mark, the avatar, the filter token's outline, the finished step dots and their line, the chosen row's 3px inner edge and the focus ring; it is not a series colour. Status colours appear only where they mean something: caution for what waits, critical for late, disputed and errors, positive for paid. No drop shadows and no gradients.
Display tracking -0.024em on .lg-head h1; .lg declares 400 1rem/1.5 and no body tracking.
Transition easing is not authored on .lg-inv, so motionEasing is null; the browser default is ease.
Radius 12px is the white panel, .lg-panel; the shell around it, .lg-shell, is 16px, the match strip, .lg-match, 8px and the filter token, .lg-token, 6px.
At max-width: 480px the page sets its own scale again with !important against the shared phone overrides: h1 1.625rem/1.15, p and li 1rem/1.5.
Typography recipe: operational. Display and body font, size, weight, line-height, and letter-spacing stay on the authored source values.
provenance.adaptation: Scalar source primitives are preserved where authored. Heading, label, caption, and numeric/code roles follow the named typography recipe rather than one shared scale.
